PreviaLoading.Dica: Shows the loading screen for a few seconds. Click it to close.

PreviaPausa.Dica: Shows the pause screen. Click it to close.

loadingAtivo.Dica: Shows the custom screen when opening the world and changing scenes.

loadingFundo.Dica: Image or video (webm/mp4) covering the whole screen. Empty = dark background.

loadingLogo.Dica: Small image above the title. Empty = no logo.

loadingChamada.Dica: Small text above the title. E.g. "The story continues..."

loadingTitulo.Dica: Large title (e.g. campaign name). Empty = world title.

loadingFrases.Dica: Random quotes below the bar, separated by | (pipe).

mostrarNomeCena.Dica: Shows "Loading <scene>...". Uses the scene navigation name when set.

duracaoMinima.Dica: Minimum time on screen when changing scenes, so light scenes don't flash.

pausaSubtitulo.Dica: E.g. "Be right back...". Empty = no subtitle.

pausaImagem.Dica: Central icon of the pause screen. Empty = no image.

pausaFrases.Dica: Random quote on each pause, separated by | (pipe). Empty = no quote.

pausaDesfoque.Dica: Blur applied to the table while paused.

corPrimaria.Dica: Hex color (e.g. #e0452b). Start of the pause title and subtitle.

corSecundaria.Dica: Hex color (e.g. #5b7cff). End of the pause title, title glow and progress bar.

fonteTitulo.Dica: Font name. A Foundry font or one added in Core Settings → Additional Fonts.

fonteFrase.Dica: Font name or CSS list (e.g. Courier New, monospace).

Avisos.LoadingDesativado: The loading screen is disabled in the settings.
